verdict.rationale: FutureHouse provides an official Python client (`edison-client`) with documented installation, API-key auth, and code samples for running tasks (task creation, run_tasks_until_done), which supports AI-native, programmatic use. However, the probe shows the cookbook root page 404s and no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found, raising doubts about doc freshness and completeness of the SDK reference. Missing for 10: live/consistent documentation site, evidence of multi-language or broader API coverage, independent/community corroboration of SDK usage.
